nights.title: TONY HADLEY - The Christmas Big Band Tour 2026
nights.name: Tony Hadley
nights.extract: Anthony Patrick Hadley is an English pop singer. He rose to fame in the 1980s as the lead singer of the new wave band Spandau Ballet and launched a solo career following the group's split in 1990. Hadley returned to the band in 2009 but left again in 2017, and has since toured regularly as a solo artist. Hadley has been noted for his expressive voice and vocal range.

tr.who: Tony Hadley, Spandau Ballet grubunun solisti olarak tanınan bir ingiliz pop şarkıcısıdır. grup 1990'da dağılınca solo kariyerine başladı ve 2017'de gruptan yeniden ayrıldıktan sonra düzenli olarak solo sanatçı olarak turneye çıkıyor.

nights.title: Seb Lowe
nights.name: Seb Lowe
nights.extract: Sebastian Lowe is an English singer-songwriter from Saddleworth, Greater Manchester. He is known for incorporating politics into his music, having started out uploading videos of his songs to TikTok.
